notes: All numeric stats come from Module:Hero/data, the Lua table used by {{Infobox hero}} and {{Hero stats}} on every hero page.
perLevel = (level15 - level1) / 14, i.e. linear growth as computed by the wiki's Template:Hero stats. The wiki only stores level 1 and level 15 values.

Units: HP/mana/attack/defense are flat points; attackSpeed is attacks per second; attackSpeedRatio is the % of bonus attack speed the hero converts; movementSpeed is in game speed units; basicAttackRange is in in-game 'units' (wiki convention, melee heroes are ~1.5-2); hpRegen and manaRegen are per-second-ish values as shown in-game (the wiki does not state whether per 1s or per 5s).
magicPower is not stored per hero: Template:Hero stats shows 0 base Magic Power for every hero (MLBB heroes start with 0 Magic Power).
critDamage is not in the module: Template:Hero stats hard-codes 200% for all heroes except Natalia 150%, Lesley 140%, Ling 150%.

resource: 'Mana', 'Energy', 'None' (no resource bar) or 'Rage/Indicator' (module value 'Resource#Rage/Indicator|None': heroes with a rage bar or custom indicator and no mana; resourceRaw keeps the original). For non-mana heroes mana fields are null or 0.
The 'Mystery Hero' placeholder entry of the module is skipped.

Pages in Category:Heroes without an entry in Module:Hero/data (not heroes or not yet added): Assassin, Cancelled heroes, EXP Laner, Fighter, Gold Laner, Heavenly Artifacts, Hero roles, Heroes, Jungler, Lightborn, List of heroes, Mage, Marksman, Mid Laner, Oriental Fighters, Roamer, S.A.B.E.R., Side Laner, Support, Tank, V.E.N.O.M..

Non-mana heroes: Balmond (None), Alice (Rage/Indicator), Alucard (None), Fanny (Energy), Minotaur (None), Hayabusa (Energy), Freya (None), Natalia (Rage/Indicator), Chou (Rage/Indicator), Johnson (None), Hilda (None), Lapu-Lapu (Rage/Indicator), Gatotkaca (Rage/Indicator), Irithel (Energy), Grock (Rage/Indicator), Argus (Rage/Indicator), Helcurt (Rage/Indicator), Lesley (Energy), Martis (None), Kaja (Rage/Indicator), Leomord (Rage/Indicator), Hanzo (Energy), Kimmy (None), Thamuz (Rage/Indicator), Badang (None), Granger (Energy), Guinevere (Rage/Indicator), Terizla (None), X.Borg (Energy), Ling (Energy), Dyrroth (Rage/Indicator), Masha (Rage/Indicator), Yu Zhong (None), Khaleed (Rage/Indicator), Paquito (None), Beatrix (None), Phoveus (Rage/Indicator), Aulus (None), Edith (Rage/Indicator), Yin (None), Fredrinn (None), Joy (None), Arlott (None), Nolan (Energy), Cici (None), Suyou (None), Lukas (Rage/Indicator), Kalea (None), Sora (Rage/Indicator), Hirara (Energy).
